notes.title: 🛠️ Dragonscale Monastery – Demo Updated! 🐉
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers!
We’re excited to announce that the updated version of the Dragonscale Monastery demo is now available on Steam! 🔥

What’s new?
✨ We’ve implemented your feedback on mechanics and visuals – thank you for all your suggestions!
🎨 The updated visuals and user interface bring the world to life and better reflect the atmosphere we’re aiming for.
🐲 The demo now more accurately represents the current state of development.

Step back into the mysterious world of Dragonscale Monastery and let us know what you think! 🐉

➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446660/Dragonscale_Monastery/

💬 Got ideas for the game’s future? Join our community on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/jGD2UNbh5H

Cheers!
The Dragonscale Monastery Team

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Dragon trainer building
notes.content:
Greetings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395397/72ccf14e0306d169026c6c524967a140b14711c6.png[/img]
Young monks gain experience by completing tasks in the monastery. You can move them to an adept house when you decide to promote a monk. They can then start working in more challenging roles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395397/dfe8d46fd216839279497e52b072370d74268909.png[/img]
Only adepts can become dragon trainers. Thanks to their experience, they can control their emotions and fear enough to become tutors for young dragons. This is a demanding task - if a dragon does not trust its mentor it may even devour him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395397/e3ce4311332bb7a6316507a30440fbb75b125be2.png[/img]
Dragons can be trained in different traits. If your dragon is experienced enough you can teach it special skills.

notes.title: Devlog #1 - art direction
notes.content:
Greetings esteemed leaders of Dragonscale Monastery!

We have a deep appreciation for art. It's not about flashy visuals, but crafting a genuine, immersive experience. Those little details? We spend extra time on them because we believe they enrich the overall gameplay. For us, it's all about striking the right balance and ensuring every piece complements the story we're trying to tell.

[b]Concept Art[/b]
Our initial sketches are now refined. Every design element serves a narrative and aesthetic purpose.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395397/62c5cd64a010f0c3771812a89e98ac13e3ec4657.png[/img]
[b]Colour & Perspective[/b]
Introducing vibrant colors and shading that breathe life into the sketches. Accompanying this, we've provided different angles showcasing the architectural detail from a bird's eye view.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395397/a84ebe885147f22b338741f10cba7205c7369abb.png[/img]
[b]3D Model Integration[/b]
Watch our concepts translate seamlessly into 3D. The building, as viewed from various perspectives, integrates perfectly with the environment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395397/e4f5e1fe1444fab71989e1fce5749ad2b34c0e34.png[/img]

notes.title: Dragonscale Monastery announcement
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the early development of [b]Dragonscale Monastery.[/b]

Venture into a survival city-builder game where you tame a mountain peak, build a dragon sanctuary, and face the challenges of harsh winters and scarce resources.

We want to know what you think! Visit our Steam discussion page, provide your feedback and ideas. Your insight is crucial in shaping the game. 

Thank you for being a part of our journey.
